title: How ZIP Files Make Data Smaller

aiSpeech.voice_selection: User-selected narration voice; one continuous take; no alternate voice used
aiSpeech.tempo_algorithm: FFmpeg atempo WSOLA; pitch preserved; never faster than source
aiSpeech.alignment: faster-whisper medium.en word timestamps on exact paced narration master
aiSpeech.asr_tail_filter: Excluded 0 ASR tokens beginning in digital silence at or after 44.986021s
aiSpeech.asr_spurious_token_filter: Excluded 0 ASR tokens lasting <=0.10s with probability <0.20; exact full-script match still required

scenes.title: Use fewer bits for common symbols

vo.text: The phrase science is fun appears three times.
vo.speak: The phrase science is fun appears three times.

vo.text: Instead of writing every repeat, a compressor can store a phrase once.
vo.speak: Instead of writing every repeat, a compressor can store a phrase once.

vo.text: Later repeats become short references to that earlier phrase.
vo.speak: Later repeats become short references to that earlier phrase.

vo.text: The remaining symbols are then translated into bits.
vo.speak: The remaining symbols are then translated into bits.

vo.text: Common symbols can use shorter bit patterns than rare ones.
vo.speak: Common symbols can use shorter bit patterns than rare ones.

vo.text: To open the file, the reader follows the references and rebuilds every original character.
vo.speak: To open the file, the reader follows the references and rebuilds every original character.

vo.text: Nothing is guessed. Nothing is lost.
vo.speak: Nothing is guessed. Nothing is lost.

vo.text: But already-compressed data may barely shrink.
vo.speak: But already-compressed data may barely shrink.

vo.text: ZIP saves space only when it finds useful structure.
vo.speak: ZIP saves space only when it finds useful structure.

vo.text: Compression is not deleting information. It is writing the same information more efficiently.
vo.speak: Compression is not deleting information. It is writing the same information more efficiently.
